info.description: A journal/blog article with rich-text content, cover image, author, and category.

content-manager.label: Title
content-manager.description: The display title shown on the page and in browser tabs.

content-manager.label: URL Slug
content-manager.description: URL path segment, auto-generated from the title. E.g. "our-classes" → /our-classes.

content-manager.label: Summary
content-manager.description: Short summary shown in listings and search results (1–2 sentences, plain text).

content-manager.label: Body Content
content-manager.description: Main body of this entry — supports rich text, images, and embeds.

content-manager.label: Cover Image
content-manager.description: Full-width feature image shown at the top of the page or post.

content-manager.label: Author
content-manager.description: The person who wrote this post.

content-manager.label: FAQ Category
content-manager.description: Groups this question with related FAQs on the FAQ page.

content-manager.label: Tags
content-manager.description: Keywords for filtering and discovery — enter one tag per entry.

content-manager.label: Reading Time (minutes)
content-manager.description: Estimated reading time. Leave blank to auto-calculate from word count.

content-manager.label: Featured?
content-manager.description: Featured items appear in homepage sections and spotlights.

content-manager.label: Published Date
content-manager.description: Date and time this post was published.

content-manager.label: SEO Settings
content-manager.description: Search engine optimisation settings for this page.
